author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Bradish to start Sunday
desc: Kyle Bradish will start for the Orioles on Sunday against the Astros.
impact: Bradish will close the first series out of the All-Star break for Baltimore. He posted a strong 3.61 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Rogers to start Saturday
desc: Trevor Rogers will start for the Orioles on Saturday against the Astros.
impact: Rogers has allowed two runs or less in five straight starts. He will look to carry that momentum into the rest of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dean Kremer to start Friday
desc: Dean Kremer will start for the Orioles on Friday against the Astros.
impact: Kremer will take the mound in Baltimore's first game back from the All-Star break. He posted a 4.09 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Encarnacion-Strand recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Orioles recalled Christian Encarnacion-Strand from Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Encarnacion-Strand was hitting .273 with 17 homers and an .863 OPS over 61 games in Triple-A. He gets the opportunity with Blaze Alexander placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blaze Alexander (hand) placed on IL
desc: The Orioles placed Blaze Alexander on the injured list with a left hand fracture.
impact: Alexander suffered the injury in the Orioles final game before the All-Star break. Christian Encarnacion-Strand was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Greg Jones elects free agency
desc: Greg Jones has elected free agency.
impact: Jones passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will be free to sign with another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Johnson to start Sunday
desc: Ryan Johnson will start on Sunday against the Tigers.
impact: Johnson will close out the first series back from the All-Star break for the Angels. He posted a 6.75 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grayson Rodriguez to start Saturday
desc: Grayson Rodriguez will start on Saturday against the Tigers.
impact: Rodriguez allowed three runs over 5 1/3 innings against the Twins in his return from the injured list before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Reid Detmers to start Friday
desc: Reid Detmers will start on Friday against the Tigers.
impact: Detmers will take the mound first for the Angels out of the All-Star break. He has struggled across two starts so far in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Brown to start Sunday
desc: Hunter Brown will start on Sunday against the Orioles.
impact: Brown will close out the first series back from the All-Star break for the Astros. He posted a 3.57 ERA into the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Arrighetti to start Saturday
desc: Spencer Arrighetti will start for the Astros on Saturday against the Orioles.
impact: Arrighetti struggled to end the first half of the season after dominating through May. He'll be looking to get back on track the rest of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Peter Lambert to start Friday for Astros
desc: Peter Lambert will start on Friday against the Orioles.
impact: Lambert will take the mound for the Astros first out of the All-Star break. He posted a strong 3.14 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Ryan not starting this weekend
desc: Joe Ryan is not starting in the Twins first series back this weekend against the Cubs.
impact: It will be Bailey Ober, Taj Bradley and Zebby Matthews starting for the Twins this weekend. Ryan could start Monday's series opener against the Guardians.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zebby Matthews to start Sunday
desc: Zebby Matthews will start on Sunday against the Cubs.
impact: Matthews will finish the first series back from the All-Star break. He posted a 4.57 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Taj Bradley to start Saturday
desc: Taj Bradley will start for the Twins on Saturday against the Cubs.
impact: Bradley delivered a strong 3.59 ERA over the first half of the season. He has posted a 1.89 ERA across three starts in July.
